result.title: PLANE: Plug-and-Play Fine-Grained Visual Experts for Hallucination Mitigation in Large Vision-Language Models
result.summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) commonly suffer from hallucinations, which appear as fabricating non-existent objects or outputting incorrect attributes and spatial relationships in images. Previous works empirically indicate that CLIP-style vision encoders tend to focus on primary objects while ignoring image details, which is one of the causes of hallucinations. To address this issue, we propose plug-and-play fine-grained visual experts (PLANE) comprising two components: LoRA visual experts operating on CLIP for multi-aspect image encoding, and an instruction-aware gate network for adaptive image feature fusion. During training, we construct a fine-grained image-caption pairs dataset, where images are described from three aspects: objects, attributes, and relations between objects. Image-caption pairs from different aspects are used to train the three fine-grained LoRA experts respectively. Aiming at comprehensively evaluate our method's capabilities, we manually annotate a fine-grained hallucination evaluation benchmark for LVLMs which is GPT4-independent during evaluation phase (GIFT). We conduct experiments both on popular hallucination evaluation benchmarks and GIFT. The results show that our method effectively reduces hallucinations across models of different types and sizes while introducing minimal inference latency. Compared to advanced baselines, our model also demonstrates superior performance.

AI.brief_summary: 提出即插即用的 PLANE：在 CLIP 上以三个 LoRA 视觉专家分别从对象、属性、对象关系三个方面编码图像，并用指令感知门控网络自适应融合特征，以缓解 LVLM 幻觉；同时人工标注了不依赖 GPT4 的细粒度幻觉评测基准 GIFT。
AI.relevance_reason: 其问题正是「视觉细节与实体关系是否保留在内部表示」，多专家分面编码与指令感知融合可作为视觉证据筛选与使用方式的核查线索，GIFT 亦可能用于诊断 latent 内容是否承载细粒度视觉信息。
